tables.name: public.active_customers
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW active_customers AS (
 SELECT id,
    email,
    name,
    country,
    created_at
   FROM customers
  WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
)

tables.name: public.product_sales
tables.comment: Units sold and revenue per product, refreshed nightly
tables.def:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW product_sales AS (
 SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    p.name,
    sum(i.quantity) AS units_sold,
    sum(((i.quantity)::numeric * i.unit_price)) AS revenue
   FROM ((products p
     JOIN order_items i ON ((i.product_id = p.id)))
     JOIN orders o ON ((o.id = i.order_id)))
  WHERE (o.status <> 'cancelled'::order_status)
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
)
